actions.text: Received in the Senate and Read twice and referred to the Committee on Foreign Relations.
The title of the measure was amended. Agreed to without objection.
Motion to reconsider laid on the table Agreed to without objection.
On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended Agreed to by voice vote. (text: CR H3734)
Passed/agreed to in House: On motion to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended Agreed to by voice vote. (text: CR H3734)
DEBATE - The House proceeded with forty minutes of debate on H.R. 4490.
Considered under suspension of the rules. (consideration: CR H3734-3736)
Mr. Baumgartner moved to suspend the rules and pass the bill, as amended.
Ordered to be Reported by Voice Vote.
Committee Consideration and Mark-up Session Held
Referred to the House Committee on Foreign Affairs.

dimensions.assessment: Directly affects personnel and missions associated with ASEAN, the Pacific Islands Forum, CARICOM, CERN, and the African Union.
dimensions.evidence: The bill authorizes the President to extend diplomatic immunities and privileges provided by the International Organizations Immunities Act... to specified international regional and research organizations.

dimensions.assessment: Grants legal privileges such as immunity from certain lawsuits and property tax exemptions to designated international organizations.
dimensions.evidence: authorizes the President to extend diplomatic immunities and privileges provided by the International Organizations Immunities Act, including immunity from certain lawsuits and exemption from property taxes

dimensions.assessment: Involves potential local property tax exemptions and administrative actions for international missions, with no direct federal spending amounts specified in the source.
Amends the International Organizations Immunities Act to add specific regional and international research organizations to those eligible for diplomatic privileges.
dimensions.evidence: To amend the International Organizations Immunities Act to extend privileges and immunities to certain additional international and regional organizations, and for other purposes.

dimensions.assessment: Provides permanent statutory authorization for the extension of international immunities.
dimensions.evidence: The International Organizations Immunities Act (22 U.S.C. 288 et seq.) is amended by adding at the end the following new section

missing_information: Estimates of tax revenue impacts on local jurisdictions where organizations hold property.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill authorizes the President to extend diplomatic immunities and privileges under the International Organizations Immunities Act to specific international and regional organizations and the African Union mission.
